fieldDescription: Master switch to suppress weapon and system flux generation on player ships.
Requires player ships to maintain ESM power above threshold (percent) to keep shields online.
Master switch to enable or disable the Emergency Shield Restoration system.
Keybind used to activate emergency shield restoration using ESM energy.
Maximum number of shield restoration charges available per battle.
Disables charge limits for emergency shield restoration (cooldowns still apply).
Seconds required to recover 1 restoration charge in battle (0 = no in-combat recharge).
Cooldown in seconds between shield restoration uses.
Percentage of max shield HP restored per activation (0.25 = 25 percent).
If enabled energy cost is calculated as a percentage of max ESM energy. If disabled uses flat energy cost.
ESM energy cost as a fraction of maximum ship ESM capacity (0.25 = 25 percent).
Flat ESM energy cost for activating shield restoration.
